overloads.semanticRole: The Open datastore command connects the application to the remote datastore identified by the connectionInfo parameter and returns a matching 4D.DataStoreImplementation object associated with the localID local alias.

constraints: connectionInfo must describe a remote datastore whose Web Server is running with http/https enabled and which is exposed as a REST server; a 4D Client license may be required.
All connectionInfo properties are optional except hostname (host/IP + mandatory port number).

If tls is true, HTTPS is only actually used when HTTPS is enabled on the remote datastore, the port is the configured HTTPS port, and a valid certificate/private key are installed; otherwise error 1610 is raised.

If localID already names an existing local session, that session is reused; otherwise a new one is created (lazily, when the datastore object is first used). Calling ds(localID) afterwards returns a reference to the same datastore object.
Returns Null if no matching datastore is found.
